families.blurb: A weight-shared trunk (one entry block, two shared core blocks applied n times, one exit block, 6.4M parameters). Each point is the same checkpoint sampled at a different loop count; more loops cost more compute per sample.

families.title: Recurrence, one block: thoughts between statement and proof
families.blurb: Run 198's untied blocks plus T continuous thoughts after the theorem statement (the Coconut spike). A thought's input is the model's own previous output. Trained with 0 to 8 thoughts, old harness, 4 RL rounds the recipe could not change. A thought costs one extra position, so compute is nearly flat from left to right.

families.title: Recurrence, per line: a thinking round before each proof line
families.blurb: The thoughts autoresearch loop (shared harness, RL owned by the recipe). Each model was scored on the whole dev pool at 8 thoughts per line and at 0, 64 samples, three seeds (means shown). Only the 8-thought eval kept per-theorem counts, so smaller sample counts show that point alone.
